YES: build a model over a proper subset of `n.snapshots`, then call `solve_model(extra_functionality=...)`. Under legacy semantics with `"auto"` or `"multiindex"`, `_as_model_snapshots` leaves its argument unchanged, and `solve_model` supplies `n.snapshots` rather than the model’s stored snapshots, so the callback receives the full network index instead of the modelled subset.
